{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Confirm the number of missing values in body_mass_g
missing_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Missing values in body_mass_g: {missing_body_mass}')

# Filter out rows with missing body_mass_g
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = penguins_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()

print(f'Number of penguins after filtering: {len(penguins_clean)}')
print(f'Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}')"}
